relationships.dataDescription: Fixed hunk formatting and line-matching rules used for each change set.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the rules used to compute the change set.

relationships.dataDescription: The contents of each selected file, keyed by repository-relative path, together with the paths that could not be read.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the text buildChangeSet diffs against, so it can compute a change set without the service reaching the filesystem itself.

relationships.dataDescription: The same file contents, in the shape the legacy adapter expected.
relationships.purpose: Fed the adapter that ChangeService replaces, and is removed with it; nothing in the flow reads its output after the change.

relationships.dataDescription: Stored diff options: context line count, whitespace handling, and the ignore globs.
relationships.purpose: Configures the service when it is constructed. No user action triggers it, but every change set is computed under these options.

relationships.dataDescription: The paths the user selected, with the comparison target they chose.
relationships.purpose: Carries the user's change-set request. Nothing downstream runs until this arrives, and the selection it carries scopes everything that follows.

relationships.dataDescription: The validated list of paths to read.
relationships.purpose: Delegates file access to Repository, keeping the service independent of storage while gathering its input.

relationships.dataDescription: A read request for each selected path.
relationships.purpose: The only point at which this feature touches the filesystem, supplying real file state rather than cached state.

relationships.dataDescription: The bytes of each readable file, and a not-found result for the rest.
relationships.purpose: Returns the only content the change set can be computed from; the not-found results are reported as skipped files.

relationships.dataDescription: The finished change set: one entry per file with its diff hunks, plus the counts of changed and skipped files.
relationships.purpose: Delivers the retained outcome the user asked for. Until it arrives the panel still shows the state from before the request.

relationships.dataDescription: Writes the finished change set into `changes`, replacing any set retained from an earlier request.
relationships.purpose: Retains the result across the request so it can be redisplayed without recomputing the diff or re-reading the files.

relationships.dataDescription: Reads the retained change set, including its file entries and summary counts.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the displayed result without recomputing the diff or re-reading the files.

relationships.dataDescription: The pushed paths and the commit they were pushed in.
relationships.purpose: Lets automation request a change set without the panel; now routed to buildChangeSet instead of the legacy adapter.

relationships.dataDescription: The change set summary: changed and skipped file counts, keyed by request.
relationships.purpose: Notifies downstream consumers that a new change set is ready.

relationships.dataDescription: Each adapted change, one log line per file.
relationships.purpose: Recorded legacy adaptations; removed along with the adapter.
